test_astype_idempotent: test that casting an IntervalIndex to interval or its own dtype returns an equal index
test_astype_object: test converting an IntervalIndex to object dtype produces an Index of interval objects
test_astype_category: test converting an IntervalIndex to category dtype with optional custom categories and ordering
test_subtype_conversion: test converting an IntervalIndex integer subtype to float64, datetime64, or timedelta64 subtype
test_subtype_datetimelike: test that datetime IntervalIndex cannot be cast to timedelta or uint64 subtypes
